platform.description: Shared ingestion, processing, serving, and observability platform.

product.description: User activity, retention, and product performance.

operations.description: Catalog, inventory, pipeline health, and alerts.

tables.name: raw_events
tables.grain: one row per event envelope
tables.note: spark.tenant_user_session_summary_stage (spark/jobs/sessionization_job.py) reads directly from raw_events, bypassing processed_user_sessions entirely — a parallel batch sessionization path, not a downstream consumer of the async processing-service's output.

tables.name: event_outbox
tables.grain: one row per pending producer event

tables.name: event_inbox
tables.grain: one row per consumed event per consumer

tables.name: processed_orders
tables.grain: one row per tenant order

tables.name: processed_payments
tables.grain: one row per tenant payment

tables.name: processed_user_sessions
tables.grain: one row per user activity event

tables.name: tenant_metrics_hourly
tables.grain: one row per tenant per hour

tables.name: tenant_metrics_daily
tables.grain: one row per tenant per day

tables.name: service_health_metrics
tables.grain: one row per service health event

tables.name: alerts
tables.grain: one row per alert

tables.name: data_quality_score_daily
tables.grain: one row per tenant per day

tables.name: reconciliation_audit
tables.grain: one row per tenant metric reconciliation check result (check_name distinguishes revenue/payment/customer_activity checks)

tables.name: pipeline_run_log
tables.grain: one row per pipeline/job run (backfills, reliability exercises, async processing-service pipelines)

tables.name: data_quality_check_results
tables.grain: one row per data quality check per tenant per run

tables.name: lineage_events
tables.grain: one row per pipeline lineage event

tables.name: pipeline_watermarks
tables.grain: one row per pipeline, tenant, and source topic checkpoint

tables.name: privacy_erasure_requests
tables.grain: one row per tenant subject erasure request

tables.name: data_retention_policies
tables.grain: one row per table retention policy

tables.name: stream_processing_runs
tables.grain: one row per Structured Streaming job invocation

tables.name: stream_window_metrics
tables.grain: one row per tenant, event-time window, domain, and metric
tables.note: Not yet served by analytics.metrics_api — the API serves tenant_metrics_daily (async path) only; see docs/data-products.md's revenue product known_limitations. Do not add analytics.metrics_api here until the API actually queries this table.

tables.name: streaming_watermarks
tables.grain: one row per streaming run per micro-batch event-time watermark
tables.note: Written by PostgresSink.write_watermark (spark/streaming/sinks.py) but not currently read back by any service — the live watermark lag signal operators actually see is cloudscale_stream_watermark_lag_seconds (a Prometheus gauge, not a query against this table). Do not list app.ops_console as a downstream consumer until it actually queries this table.

tables.name: streaming_checkpoint_audit
tables.grain: one row per streaming query per committed micro-batch
tables.note: The consumer-interruption reliability exercise (reliability/scenarios/consumer_interruption.py) proves the same checkpoint-recovery *mechanism* but against its own isolated, ephemeral temp checkpoint directory — it never writes to this table. Do not list it as a downstream consumer here; see docs/reliability.md instead.

tables.name: streaming_failures
tables.grain: one row per streaming sink/stage failure

tables.name: streaming_late_events
tables.grain: one row per tenant per event classified late/duplicate by the streaming job

tables.name: schema_registry_subjects
tables.grain: one row per registered Kafka Schema Registry subject
tables.note: Runtime Schema Registry compatibility mode enforced per subject. scripts/validate_schema_registry.py calls this table's data via the registry's HTTP API, not by name in SQL, so it is not listed as a verifiable downstream edge here.

tables.name: schema_registry_versions
tables.grain: one row per registered schema version for a subject (immutable once written)
tables.note: Bootstrapped from contracts/registry.json by scripts/validate_schema_registry.py --bootstrap, via the registry's HTTP API (not a direct SQL reference, so not listed as a verifiable downstream edge here).

tables.name: schema_registry_compatibility_checks
tables.grain: one row per compatibility evaluation the registry has run (both real registrations and dry-run checks)
tables.note: Audit trail recording compatibility checks executed by the enforcement layer.

metrics.name: net_revenue
metrics.definition: Sum of order gross revenue minus discounts.

metrics.name: payment_failure_rate
metrics.definition: Payment failures divided by total payment attempts.

metrics.name: tenant_health_score
metrics.definition: Composite score using recent payment failures, churn signals, and event processing.

metrics.name: average_order_value
metrics.definition: Net revenue divided by order count for a tenant and period.

metrics.name: data_quality_score
metrics.definition: Daily score based on data freshness, validity, uniqueness, range, and anomaly checks.
